rationale: SVG vector lowering now carries stroke-linecap, stroke-linejoin, stroke-miterlimit, stroke-dashoffset and pathLength as IR attributes and folds a shape's own opacity into its single paint alpha, refusing shape-opacity with two paints, unfoldable paint alpha and markers. Generic Pulp lowering change; paint consumption follows separately.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'own opacity folds into its one paint'
